source_review_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened handoff_context, packet manifest, locator index, extraction reports, primary XML/PDF, OA packages, supplement PDF/text, Table 1, figures/methods, linked DBAASP/DRAMP snapshots, and merged sequence/experiment catalogs. DBAASP IC50 rows and activity finals were repaired; DRAMP conflicts remain explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.note: DRAMP rows retain unsupported antimicrobial activity and linear/free-termini modified-sequence annotations; these are preserved as conflicts rather than promoted to source_verified.
DBAASP/DRAMP symbolic X/x modified-residue strings are kept as database notation and not normalized into plain peptide sequences.
Local supplement contains Figure S1 and MS/MS/NMR/HPLC characterization figures for analogs, not additional activity/toxicity tables that change Table 1 curation.
Mechanism evidence supports HepG2 apoptosis/mitochondria-mediated pathway for Analog-6; this paper does not support antimicrobial mechanism claims.
